findings.issue: ５００００円 (50,000 yen) is transcribed digit-by-digit as ごれいれいれいれいえん. Japanese never reads prices this way; the correct reading is ごまんえん (5万円).
findings.current: あたらしいじてんしゃわごれいれいれいれいえんもした。
findings.suggested: あたらしいじてんしゃわごまんえんもした。

findings.issue: Reading of the numeral ５００００ given as digit-by-digit ごれいれいれいれい; the number 50,000 is read ごまん.
Romaji carries the same wrong digit-by-digit reading of ５００００円 (goreireireirei-en); should reflect goman'en.
何も is transcribed なんも, a very casual/dialectal contraction that clashes with the polite ありません; the standard reading (and what a learner should be taught) is なにも.
findings.current: あそこになんもありません。
findings.suggested: あそこになにもありません。

findings.issue: Token 何 in 何も should read なに here (standard なにも); なん is the colloquial contraction, inconsistent with the polite register of the sentence.
Romaji carries the same colloquial contraction (nanmo) instead of the standard nanimo.
Token list starts with two stray null-glossed tokens 進行 (index 0) and 中 (index 1) BEFORE 新しい, breaking surface order and duplicating the proper 進行中 token at index 10. Tokens 0 and 1 must be deleted.
findings.current: tokens[0]=進行, tokens[1]=中 (all-null, prepended before 新しい)
findings.suggested: delete tokens 0 and 1; 進行中 is already tokenized at index 10

findings.issue: Final note is garbled/false: 'with 言う the form する→すべき is also acceptable'. The contraction すべき applies only to する (するべき→すべき), never to 言う; as written it teaches a nonexistent form.
findings.current: Note that with 言う the form する→すべき is also acceptable, but 言うべき is equally correct.
findings.suggested: Note: する also has the contracted form すべき (from するべき); 言う simply takes べき: 言うべき.

findings.issue: Same garbled claim as expl_en: 'com 言う a forma também aceita する→すべき' is false — a contração すべき só existe para する, não para 言う.
findings.current: Note que com 言う a forma também aceita する→すべき, mas 言うべき é igualmente correto.
findings.suggested: Nota: する também tem a forma contraída すべき (de するべき); com 言う usa-se simplesmente 言うべき.

findings.issue: Leftover from another sentence: the parenthetical '(５００万円→here 50,000円)' references 5,000,000 yen, an amount not in this sentence, confusing the learner.
findings.current: The particle も after the price (５００万円→here 50,000円) gives the tone of "reached / no less than,"
findings.suggested: The particle も after the price (５００００円) gives the tone of "reached / no less than,"

findings.issue: Same template leakage as expl_en: '(５００万円→aqui 50.000円)' cites um valor (5 milhões de ienes) que não existe nesta frase.
findings.current: A partícula も depois do preço (５００万円→aqui 50.000円) dá o tom de "chegou a / nada menos que"
findings.suggested: A partícula も depois do preço (５００００円) dá o tom de "chegou a / nada menos que"

findings.issue: pt gloss of よい is a copy-paste artifact from a よくない sentence: 'bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)'. Here よい is the attributive adjective 'good' modifying 年; gloss should be 'bom'. en gloss ('good') is correct.
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)

findings.issue: 'Act your place.' is not idiomatic English (the idiom is 'know your place') and drops the 新米のくせに content and the prohibitive force of するな, unlike the accurate pt/lit fields.
findings.suggested: Don't act so big — you're just a rookie.

findings.issue: Conjugation note on token し (both languages) labels it 連用(形) as the base for 〜なければ; the negative auxiliary ない/なければ attaches to the 未然形 of する (し), not the 連用形.
findings.current: radical de する em 大事にする; forma 連用 し-, base para 〜なければ
findings.suggested: radical de する em 大事にする; forma 未然形 し-, base para 〜ない/〜なければ

findings.issue: Batch-context leakage: 'It is the only sentence in the group in the polite register' references a generation 'group' that does not exist for the learner viewing this single sentence.
findings.current: It is the only sentence in the group in the polite register (です).
findings.suggested: The sentence is in the polite register (です).

findings.issue: Same batch-context leakage as expl_en: 'É a única frase do grupo no registro polido' refere um 'grupo' inexistente para o aluno.
findings.current: É a única frase do grupo no registro polido (です).
findings.suggested: A frase está no registro polido (です).

findings.issue: en omits も ('also/too', kept in pt 'também' and in lit_en) and renders perfective でてきました as progressive 'was coming up'; inconsistent with the rest of the record.
findings.current: A new moon was coming up.
findings.suggested: A new moon had come out, too.
